wrong: If something is wrong, it is not right. If something is wrong it may be incorrect, not true, or bad.
If something is wrong, it is not moral.
If you wrong someone, you do something that hurts a person.
He wrongs you by his actions.
A wrong is an immoral act.
They accused him of wrongs against humanity.
writing: A subject in school where you write stories and poems.
She is taking a class in creative writing.
write: If you write a book, an article, a computer program, a piece of music, etc., you create it.
My dream is to write a children's book.
If you write, you use letters, numbers, or other marks on paper or on a computer to show words.
Can you write your name and phone number here for me?
If you write, you send a letter to someone.
Please, phone or write me when you have some time.
(computer) If a computer writes, it records something in its memory or on a disk.
Old computers were much slower at writing files.
written: If something is written it is in writing.
We have a written letter from our CEO.
writer: A writer is a person who writes books or other things that people read.
She works as a writer for a magazine.
wrist: Someone's wrist is a part of their body where the arm joins the hand.
You can move your hand up and down while keeping your arm in one place by bending your wrist.
wreck: A wreck is what is left of something that has been seriously damaged.
The wreck of the Titanic was found on the bottom of the sea.
If you wreck something, you harm it beyond repair.
writings: The writings of an author are their books, articles, and other things they have written.
The library has collected all of her scientific writings.
wristband: A wristband is a piece of cloth, plastic or metal that you wear on your wrist.
The boy wore a grey wristband on his left wrist.
the cuff of a sleeve that wraps around the wrist
a band that holds a wristwatch on the wrist
wrap: If you wrap something you cover it with something like paper or cloth. This might be done by winding the paper or cloth over it.
I wrapped the gifts in paper.
If you wrap something up you finish it.
We need to wrap up this meeting and get back to work.
A piece of clothing that you can wrap around your body to keep warm.
Something you wrap things in; a wrapper.
I bought some giftwrap from the gift.
A food wrapped in soft bread.
I had a chicken wrap for lunch.
You can say, "That's a wrap!" to say you have finished something.
wrestle: If two people wrestle, they fight by holding, pushing, and pulling each other.
The two men who wrestled in the TV show were very young.
A wrestle is a fight with pushing and pulling, often a play fight.
The wrestle between the two men on the street was hard.
wrestling: Wrestling is a sport where two or more people fight against each other.
Many people like it to watch wrestling shows on TV.
wretchedness: Wretchedness is an unhappy state of pain of the mind and body.
Wretchedness is a long state of very bad luck.
wrinkle: A wrinkle is a line or crease on old and fragile skin, usually caused by old age or tiredness.
My grandfather had a lot of wrinkles on his face.
To wrinkle is to make lines, creases, or folds on a smooth surface.
When he smiled, his face wrinkled.
wry: If someone is being wry then they are being sarcastically humorous.
wretched: When someone is wretched, they are either cursed, or unhappy.
When something is wretched, it means that it is really bad or terrible.
wretchedly: If something is done wretchedly, it is done in a terrible manner.
wrapper: A wrapper is something that wraps something else.
writ: A writ is a document form a court that says you have to do something.
The writ was given to tell information to everyone.
wrench: A wrench is a tool that is used to adjust nuts and bolts.
wrestler: A wrestler is a person who takes part in wrestling as a sport.
wriggle: If a person wriggles, they twist their body to and fro with short and quick motions.
A wriggle is a wriggling movement.
wrinkly: If something is wrinkly, it has wrinkles.
wrongly: If you do something wrongly, you do it in a wrong way.
wreckage: The wreckage of something, is the remains or debris of it after it has been severely damaged or destroyed.
wrongdoer: A wrongdoer is someone who does something wrong.
wrongdoing: A wrongdoing is an illegal or dishonest action..
A wrongdoing is an instance of doing wrong.
wrongful: A wrongful act is one that is violates somebody's rights.
His wrongful conviction for the crime was eventually overturned.
A wrongful act is one that is illegal.
He was charged for the wrongful death of the cyclist.
A wrongful heir, possessor, etc. is one that has no right to be in that position.
The wrongful heir claimed the throne, causing a dispute.
wring: If you wring something from somebody, you get it from them after hard bargaining.
The union managed to wring a 4% wage increase from the employer.
If you wring (out) something wet, you squeeze or twist it tightly to force out the liquid in it.
Please, wring out the cloth before hanging it up.
If you wring your hands, you rub them together because you're worried about something.
If you wring an animal's neck, you kill it by twisting its neck.
wrangle: If you wrangle with another person, you have a long and angry dispute with them.
A wrangle is an angry dispute or quarrel.
wreath: A wreath is a circular arrangement of flowers, leaves, or branches, often used as a decoration or symbol.
They hung a wreath on the door for Christmas.
A wreath is a circular arrangement placed on graves to honour the dead.
A wreath of poppies was laid at the memorial.
If x is wreathed in or with y, it is covered or surrounded by it in a circular or curved way.
Mist wreathed the mountains at sunrise.
If x is wreathed in or with y, it is decorated with a wreath of y.
They wreathed the statue with flowers.
